# Third-party assets

Unmodified assets retained locally to avoid a runtime dependency on CDNs.

- Font Awesome Free 7.2.0, https://fontawesome.com/. See `fontawesome/LICENSE` for font, icon and code licenses.
- Academicons 1.9.5 by James Walsh, https://github.com/jpswalsh/academicons. Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1; CSS: MIT. See `academicons/README.upstream.md` and https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/.
- Scholar Icons 1.0.3 by Louis Facun, https://github.com/louisfacun/scholar-icons. Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1; CSS: MIT; icons: CC BY 4.0. See `scholar-icons/README.upstream.md` and license notices in its CSS.
- vanilla-back-to-top 7.2.1, https://github.com/vfeskov/vanilla-back-to-top. MIT; see `vanilla-back-to-top/LICENSE`.

Icon CSS files were verified against the SHA-256 integrity hashes in the upstream al-folio configuration. CSS and font data are copied without transformation; Jekyll does not minify the static vendor files.
